ideas.pitch: An AI-powered candidate screening and hiring mismatch detector that parses technical portfolios and live coding video submissions to flag inflated resumes for remote recruiters.
ideas.title: TalentSignal AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since this is a hiring-focused hackathon, building a tool that solves recruiter fatigue and hiring friction directly targets a pain the judges feel themselves.

ideas.pitch: A milestone-based freelance marketplace tailored for hackathon projects, using automated code verification to release funds safely upon passing GitHub workflow tests.
ideas.title: SkillEscrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex product thinking and a concrete economic benefit, matching patterns of winners that solve real monetary trust problems.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and drone image monitoring dashboard that automatically flags unauthorized industrial zoning changes and environmental compliance breaches.
ideas.title: AeroCompliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features genuinely hard technical execution combining geospatial data processing with computer vision classification.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered logistics scheduler that groups isolated seniors into community social outings and matches them with verified local volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: ElderRoute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents clear, quantifiable social impact and solves a deeply felt community accessibility problem.

ideas.pitch: An automated Anti-Money Laundering risk detection platform utilizing graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models to trace suspicious transaction clusters.
ideas.title: RiskGraph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relies on advanced graph intelligence and rigorous mathematical modeling that immediately impresses technical judges.
